## Stay Updated

Get notified when **LUO Qun (罗群)** publishes new articles, research notes, or projects. Confirm your email using the link sent after you subscribe. For subscription changes, contact [qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com](mailto:qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com).

```{=html}
<form id="ql-subscribe-form" class="ql-subscribe-container">
  <label for="ql-subscribe-email">Email address</label>
  <input type="email" id="ql-subscribe-email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="your.email@example.com" maxlength="320" required>
  <div class="ql-turnstile-box">
    <div class="cf-turnstile" data-language="en" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAACzZJprJ4npD9l7W" data-callback="qlOnTurnstileSuccess" data-expired-callback="qlOnTurnstileExpired" data-error-callback="qlOnTurnstileError" data-size="flexible"></div>
  </div>
  <button id="ql-subscribe-submit" class="ql-btn-primary" type="submit">Subscribe</button>
  <p id="ql-subscribe-status" class="ql-status-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>
```
